entries.title: The Five Great Shinobi Nations
entries.summary: Five major nations support hidden villages, each with its own political interests, leaders, and shinobi traditions.

entries.title: Hidden Leaf Village
entries.summary: The Hidden Leaf is the shinobi village of the Land of Fire. The Hokage leads it, while clans, academy teams, missions, and village councils shape daily life.

entries.title: The Ninja Academy
entries.summary: Students learn fundamentals such as chakra control, teamwork, field judgment, and the basic techniques required for graduation.

entries.title: Chakra
entries.summary: Chakra combines physical and spiritual energy. Control, reserves, technique requirements, and the user's condition all matter when using jutsu.

entries.title: Clan Lineages
entries.summary: Some abilities are associated with inherited bloodlines. Their presence does not guarantee awakening; experience, stress, and the story can shape whether they emerge.

entries.title: Village Missions
entries.summary: The village assigns work according to rank, skill, trust, and political need. Mission outcomes can change reputation and relationships.

entries.title: Land of Waves
entries.summary: A small coastal nation whose people depend on trade and a major bridge. Outside interests can make local infrastructure a political flashpoint.
